description: This file defines the AuthenticatorActivity class, which displays a login screen for user authentication in an Android app. It manages user input, initiates background authentication tasks, and handles account management interactions.

classes.name: AuthenticatorActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays a login screen for user authentication, manages credentials, and communicates with the server to authenticate user credentials and manage account data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and retrieves intent data.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns a progress dialog shown during authentication.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles the login button click, starts the background authentication task if input is valid.

methods.name: finishConfirmCredentials
methods.description: Completes the confirmation of user credentials without changing account data.

methods.name: finishLogin
methods.description: Finalizes login, stores credentials, and updates account manager.

methods.name: onAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Handles the outcome of the authentication attempt, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onAuthenticationCancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of the authentication task.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Generates user feedback messages based on current input state.

methods.name: showProgress
methods.description: Displays the progress dialog during task execution.

methods.name: UserLoginTask
methods.description: Inner class representing an asynchronous task that performs server authentication.
